units.rawText: Unlike other Dolls who might be more romantic in nature, I tend to have... issues with expressing myself.

units.rawText: Sometimes I find myself a little envious and wishing that my feelings were not confined to mere paper and text... Never mind, I'm fine the way I am now.

units.rawText: Compared to taikonauts, who are the center of attention, being part of the ground control staff is nowhere nearly as glorious.

units.rawText: However, that suits me just fine—all I need to do is give my best effort so my friends in space can walk through the void with no worries.
